title: Career Roadmap · Farm Supervisor
summary: A Farm Supervisor coordinates daily farm operations, including crop planning, irrigation, labour allocation, input use, equipment scheduling, field monitoring and harvest records.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Agriculture / Horticulture or relevant farm-management training; requirements depend on the employer.

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Agriculture or Science with Biology; accepted streams vary by course.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Agriculture, biology, chemistry, mathematics and basic economics.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Diploma and degree requirements depend on the institution.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Crop production, soil health, irrigation, farm machinery and horticulture.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Planning, team coordination, field observation, recordkeeping and basic digital skills.

items.text: Diploma in Agriculture → Crop production, farm operations and eligible supervisory roles.
Diploma in Horticulture → Orchard, nursery, vegetable and protected-cultivation supervision.
Diploma in Sericulture → Silkworm-rearing and silk-production farm operations.
B.Sc. Agriculture → Broader technical, farm-management and agricultural extension opportunities.
B.Sc. Horticulture → Horticultural production, nursery management and specialised farm operations.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Some employers accept relevant diplomas for supervisory roles; others require a degree and prior experience. Verify the exact vacancy requirements.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Crop science, soil basics, irrigation, farm records and workplace safety.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Labour allocation, crop monitoring, input management, machinery scheduling and harvest planning.

blocks.label: Year 3, if applicable
blocks.text: Farm budgeting, inventory, sustainable agriculture and supervised fieldwork.

blocks.label: Final stage
blocks.text: Farm project, practical experience and job preparation.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Seasonal farm calendar • Irrigation-use tracker • Crop-cost and yield spreadsheet • Farm safety and equipment-maintenance checklist.

blocks.label: Government / research
blocks.text: Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs), agricultural universities, research farms and state agriculture departments.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Commercial farms, horticulture enterprises, seed companies, agri-tech startups and farm-management businesses.

blocks.label: Ideal exposure
blocks.text: Crop scheduling, labour coordination, soil and water management, inventory control and harvest operations.
KVKs provide agricultural demonstrations, practical training and extension support; availability depends on the centre and programme.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Farm Supervisor, Farm Team Leader, Crop Production Technician, Horticulture Supervisor, Assistant Farm Manager.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Commercial farming, horticulture, greenhouse production, plantations and agricultural technology.
Direct employment depends on experience, local requirements, language and visa eligibility. Sponsorship is not guaranteed.
Agriculture Student ↓ Farm Trainee ↓ Farm Supervisor ↓ Senior Farm Supervisor ↓ Assistant Farm Manager ↓ Farm Operations Manager ↓ Agribusiness Manager / Farm Entrepreneur
Progression depends on experience, qualifications, farm size and employer structure.
